Press a keyboard key (Enter) and verify success

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'browser' => { 'mode' => 'always' } }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.interact(engine, url, [{ 'selector' => '#searchbox', 'type' => 'click' }, { 'selector' => '#searchbox', 'text' => 'test', 'type' => 'type' }, { 'key' => 'Enter', 'type' => 'press' }])
puts result.action_results[2].success.inspect
puts result.action_results[2].action_type.inspect
puts result.action_results[2].action_index.inspect
```
